text: 【时隔11年 恢复对锂电池等产品征收消费税 专家：引导新能源制造业优质优价 业内人士：推动行业出清和结构优化】中国光伏行业协会咨询专家吕锦标称，新政主要还是引导新能源制造业不要低价竞争，应该优质优价。消费税为价内税，在产品生产、委托加工、进口环节由生产/加工/进口企业缴纳，把电池类产品纳入消费税，主要体现对节能环保的促进。
text_en: [After 11 years, consumption tax on lithium batteries and other products is reinstated; Experts: Guide new energy manufacturing towards high quality and fair pricing; Industry insiders: Drive industry consolidation and structural optimization.] Lu Jinbiao, an expert consultant for the China Photovoltaic Industry Association, said the new policy mainly aims to guide new energy manufacturing away from low-price competition, towards high quality and fair pricing. Consumption tax is an in-price tax, paid by production/processing/import companies during production, commissioned processing, or import stages. Including battery products under the consumption tax mainly reflects a promotion of energy conservation and environmental protection.
